datasets.contamination_policy: Thresholds, prompts and hyperparameters are tuned only against the datasets whose split_role is 'tuning'. A dataset with the role 'validation' may be scored but never tuned against. A dataset with the role 'held_out' may be read only by the final scoring step, and a tuning script that reads it has to fail. No dataset of this repository carries the role 'held_out' today, so no result of this repository may be presented as a generalization to unseen data.
datasets.notes: The decisions of the agent were read against this set, so it is a tuning set: the answer key of EC-19 to EC-24 was changed after an online run, the trajectory equivalence that lets get_ledger_record count as query_ledger was added for the six status lookups EC-13 to EC-18 so the tool the agent chose would count, and the questions of EC-02, EC-04 and EC-10 are the few shot examples of the system prompt of the agent with their tool plans. Thirty cases show a tendency and not a significance. It has one labeling pass and the repository has no mechanism to version a second one yet. No dataset of this repository is held out today, so no number over it is a generalization to unseen data.
datasets.source: The cases are generated by ledgerlens/eval/dataset.py over the sample ledger of data/scenarios.json: 12 from the planted scenarios and 18 natural ones from the generated tables, with the expected values read from the tables by code. They are read by ledgerlens/eval/run.py and by tests/eval/test_dataset.py.

datasets.notes: The sweep of ADR-007 used these 40 sentences as well, requiring no false supported and no false contradicted on both sets, so this set is a tuning set. The labels came from one person reading the evidence, and the reading is subjective in the judgment cases, so the 0.625 of this set guides and does not measure a rate. It has one labeling pass and the repository has no mechanism to version a second one yet. No dataset of this repository is held out today, so no number over it is a generalization to unseen data.
datasets.source: The sentences come from two online runs of the scenarios of data/scenarios.json with gpt-4.1-mini: 28 written by the model and 12 changed by hand, each with the evidence the tools returned. They are read by tests/verify/test_verification_live.py.

datasets.source: The cases are written by hand over the truth of data/scenarios.json and over the policies of data/policies/: 30 text claims with the evidence they are checked against, 7 numeric claims with the calculate envelope, and 6 coherence cases with the rule that decides them. They are read by ledgerlens/eval/dataset.py and by tests/verify/test_verification_set.py.
